patch_description: The current pipeline decides replication counts (Step 2) before GPU packing (Step 3), with no feedback between them. Per the recommendation, add a single tensorized refinement pass after Step 3: compute actual per-GPU loads, and when the hottest GPU exceeds the mean beyond a threshold, move one replica from the highest-contribution logical expert in the hottest pack to the lowest-contribution expert in the coldest pack by mutating `mlogcnt`/`phy2mlog` before re-running the packing. This jointly optimizes replication and packing, improving GPU balancedness without the expensive Python-loop swaps (keeping algorithm time low). Since after mutating replication we must recompute ranks and packing, we do the refinement on `mlogcnt` then rebuild `phy2mlog`, `phyrank`, and re-pack — all with vectorized torch ops, no Python loops over items.
